packageRules.description: These reusable/callable workflows are uses:-pinned by commit hash via copier update (or direct opt-in) in every consumer repo — a bump here only reaches consumers once go-tools cuts a new tag, so force fix (not chore) to make cocogitto's `cog bump --auto` release it. go-tools' own ci.yml is excluded: it's never consumed externally, so its own action bumps don't need a release. semantic-pr.yml is both: it's go-tools' own PR-title trigger AND the callable workflow consumers pin, so it's included here rather than excluded like ci.yml.
Same reasoning as above: template/mise.toml.jinja's tool pins only reach consumers via a new go-tools tag.
Same reasoning as above: template/hk.pkl.jinja's hk-config/jdx-hk pins only reach consumers via a new go-tools tag.
Group non-major bumps to the repo's own mise.toml into one 'dev tools' PR instead of one per tool. npm:renovate keeps its debounce schedule; Go toolchain bumps stay standalone.
Same for template/mise.toml.jinja, kept a separate group so the batch stays `fix` (per the rule above) and cuts one go-tools release + one copier fan-out instead of one per tool.
